name: dropsh
description: Entity-agnostic helper CLI for Drupal 11 JSON:API, used by the dropsh Claude skill for editorial publishing workflows.

scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:packages && vitest run -c vitest.config.integration.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.lint: biome check src/ packages/ plugins/ tests/integrations/helpers/ tests/integrations/schema/ tests/integrations/*.ts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src/ packages/ plugins/ tests/integrations/helpers/ tests/integrations/schema/ tests/integrations/*.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build

author: Christian Wiedemann <gitlab@keytec.de>
